parameters.content:
## ① COLLECT
**3 ways to run:** manual (demo) · weekly schedule (default competitor list) · **web form** (anyone enters competitors, lookback, recipient — no code).
**Config** holds defaults, sources, thresholds, models and *all prompts*.
**RSS:** Google News + Bing News per competitor, market query, IoT trade press.
**Tavily:** news search per competitor + search restricted to each competitor's **own website** (newsrooms), + market query.
Failures never stop the run — they're reported in QC.

## ② CLEAN — no AI spent yet
Relevance gate (name must appear, or official domain) · spam/stock/market-report filter · recency · cross-source near-duplicate clustering · caps · **cross-run memory**.

## ③ AI + ENRICH
**Triage agent** (cheap model): relevance, category, significance 1–5, evidence quote.
**Score & Validate**: schema + evidence checks, fallback rules.
**Tavily Extract**: reads the *full article* for significance ≥ 4.
**Writer agent**: synthesis with mandatory [ID] citations.

## ④ QC + OUTPUT
Citation guard · coverage guard · source health · enrichment check.
QC pass → auto-send. QC fail → human approval gate.
*(Email via SMTP (Gmail App Password) → you@example.com. Disk node: self-hosted only.)*
